items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was that? Westlitt Downer? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Down at Kilpin, Baton Rouge. That's the trumpet player.

ctx.x: That's the way he plays. Time to meet two days after he hit, 45. He'd stand on the corner. He'd get right there on the corner. He'd play the horn like he played harmonica. He plays too. It's a gift he got. He's playing the Liberty Bell Band.
Who was that? Westlitt Downer? Westlitt Downer, that's right.
Down at Kilpin, Baton Rouge. That's the trumpet player.
